alright sandeep, playing hard to get. i see you.

should i just start looking for workday roles with a 50% pay bump and a 4-day work week?
Looking opportunity in India. As internal consultant in HCM with atleast 50% hike

internal consultant... got it. moving from the services side to owning the system internally. smart play.

and where in india? bangalore, remote, open to anywhere?
Anywhere
I've got a sense for what you're looking for. Be back in less than a minute

Senior Consultant - SaT - National - SaT - S&E - Deal Management - Mumbai at EY

ey is hiring a sr. consultant for their deals team in mumbai. big 4 captive, so expect a safe 70-85 lpa base. you aren't configuring workday here, you're making decks about 'synergy' for m&a deals. take it if you want the brand name, skip it if you actually want to build and run an internal system.
i'm scanning through 50,000 jobs to find the perfect fit for you. you'll hear from me soon.

IN_Manager_Workday Finance_GCC_Advisory_Gurugram at PwC India

pwc is looking for a workday finance manager in gurugram.

the pay will be big4 standard, probably in the 35-45 lpa range, but don't expect startup money.

reality check: this is a finance role, not your usual hcm/payroll gig, and it's still consulting, not the internal role you wanted.

it's basically the same job you have now but with a different brand name; a pass unless you're trying to switch to finance.

Reward Operations Manager at Travelex

travelex has a reward ops manager role in mumbai. guessing it's in the 25-30 lpa range, which should hit your hike target. this isn't just running payroll; you'll use your workday skills to actually design how people get paid. it's a stretch, but it gets you out of the consulting factory and into a role where you make decisions instead of just taking tickets.
